description: paginate() in pagination.py returns the wrong items for a page and doesn't reject invalid pages. Pages are 1-indexed.
add_tag() in tags.py leaks tags between calls and modifies the list passed to it.
round_price() in money.py rounds some prices down when they should round up (e.g. 2.675 should become 2.68).
median() in stats.py gives wrong answers for some inputs, changes the caller's list, and fails badly on empty input.
top_words() in words.py miscounts words that differ only in case or punctuation, and breaks ties inconsistently.
